name: 1122 business extension: money-weighted metrics and category-to-SKU feasibility
author: B (Jinghan ZHAO)
status: Registered before computation. Exploratory and descriptive; Validation only; does not change any frozen result.
known_before_registration: All order-level 1122 numbers in experiments/1122/1122_实验方案与结果汇总.md (Validation, front/late halves).
D four-metric money-weighted coverage on P5/100: G 77.81%, L restricted 69.63%, A1 median 68.21%.
future B H4 money-weighted coverage (F6, Validation, exploratory).
1122 fusion and route C outputs were re-run into a scratch folder and matched the committed CSVs exactly; no weighted or SKU-level quantity was computed before this file was committed.

data.test_access: forbidden; the 1122 loader already drops every row on or after the cutoff and the script asserts it again

weights.W_order: gross_purchase_amount of the whole order (A snapshot orders.csv.gz), counted once per order
weights.W_target: sum of quantity x unit_price over the masked target category's lines in that order (the value of what the recommender is asked to guess)

M1_coverage.orders: 4,862 Validation orders of Profile customers (1122 route A view)
M1_coverage.rules: P5, budget 100 (primary) plus 20 and 50 (descriptive), identity = undirected combination, shared pool, as in 1122 section 1.2
M1_coverage.metric: money-weighted raw co-purchase coverage = sum W_order of covered orders / sum W_order of all orders
M1_coverage.random_control: A1 for rfm and rfm_form, seeds 1000-1099, same group_random as 1122
M1_coverage.intervals: weighted paired bootstrap versus global: resample customers (anonymous orders not present in this view), 1,500 replicates, RNG seed 1122; statistic = 100 x sum_w(left - right) / sum_w
reproduction_checks: order-level hits for global and rfm_form at budget 100 combination equal 3,667 and 3,715

M2_ladder.orders: late half (2011-03-01 to 2011-05-31) of the 4,311 maskable orders, 2,237 orders; early half reported descriptively
steps: fusion G100 + G101-200 + L1, aggregation and weights as selected on the early half by 1122 (discounted second, 1/0.25/0.25)
fusion G100 + L100 shared, as selected on the early half (discounted, 1/1/0.25)
fusion G100 + L100 restricted, as selected on the early half (discounted, 1/1/3)
descriptive_extra: fusion G200 max-aggregation variant (not selected on the early half)
M2_ladder.metric: Hit@5 weighted by W_target (primary) and W_order (secondary), plus the unweighted Hit@5 for reconciliation
M2_ladder.intervals: weighted paired bootstrap of each step against the previous step, using the 1122 Paired blocks (customer, or date for anonymous), 1,500 replicates, seed 1122
reproduction_checks: late hits: pure global popularity 586, G+global 629, G+L1 660, gated tail 684, fusion arms equal fusion_late.csv

M3_cold_start.orders: 1122 route C aggregate: 8,067 Validation orders, 7,122 with a common Top-5, all segments
M3_cold_start.systems: all eight route C systems against the same references as c_aggregate.csv
M3_cold_start.metric: Hit@5 weighted by W_target (primary) and W_order (secondary)
M3_cold_start.intervals: weighted paired bootstrap, same blocks as 1122 route C, 1,500 replicates, seed 1122
reproduction_checks: unweighted hits equal c_aggregate.csv for every system x reference x segment

part_M_money.interpretation: Descriptive. Large wholesale orders carry most of the weight and have larger baskets, so weighted results translate order-level results into sales terms and are not a better metric. No new claim is made unless the weighted and unweighted signs agree; any disagreement is reported as such.

part_S_category_to_sku.question: After a category is recommended, how often does one concrete SKU from that category match what the customer actually bought?
part_S_category_to_sku.orders: same 4,311 maskable orders (route A/B view); late half 2,237 primary, full and early half descriptive
part_S_category_to_sku.hidden_sku_set: stock codes on the masked target category's lines in that order (all of them were masked before any feature was computed)

sku_choice.S_pop: Discovery training orders (the 7,521 orders the rules were mined on): within the category, SKU with the most orders containing it; ties by stock_code ascending
sku_choice.S_hist: the customer's own valid orders strictly before this order's invoice_datetime (from 2009-12-01): within the category, SKU in the most of those orders; ties by most recent purchase, then by S_pop rank; fall back to S_pop when the customer never bought the category
sku_choice.S_hist_frozen: sensitivity: same as S_hist but history limited to orders before 2010-12-01, matching the frozen rules

part_S_category_to_sku.slots: one SKU per recommended category (primary, keeps five slots); three SKUs per category reported descriptively

metrics.conditional_sku_rate: share of masked orders whose chosen SKU for the target category is in the hidden SKU set; equals SKU-hit given category-hit because the choice does not depend on the ranking
metrics.sku_hit_at_5: category hit at 5 AND chosen SKU for the target category in the hidden set

part_S_category_to_sku.intervals: paired bootstrap S_hist versus S_pop on each system, 1122 Paired blocks, 1,500 replicates, seed 1122
part_S_category_to_sku.interpretation: Descriptive feasibility check. SKU-level and category-level rates are not compared as better or worse; only the share that survives the category-to-SKU step is reported. History uses information available at order time, which a deployed system would also have.

not_done: No basket-size-matched (B2) control for 1122 route A; this registration does not address it.
No SKU step on route C first-order or anonymous orders.
